# Outreach drafter setup

Initial request: Build an agent that drafts personalized outreach emails for a list of CRM contacts.

Displayed trigger: Manual
Trigger guidance: Runs when you ask it to draft outreach for a list.
Treat this trigger text as setup guidance only. Do not activate an automation unless the user asks for it and confirms its exact settings.

Connection choices:
- `read-the-contact-list` (required): Read the contact list. Options: hubspot, salesforce, attio. Read contact lists
- `hold-the-drafts` (optional): Hold the drafts. Options: gmail. Hold the drafts
